name: Wu Chong Xintiao
source:
Five Heartbeats is a Furry Visual Novel that immerses you in urban romance. It revolves around the daily lives of the five main characters and focuses on symbiosis and emotional healing, depicting the boundaries, misunderstandings, and reconnection between humans and beasts.

You will play the role of a newly graduated human young man who unexpectedly meets four male furry characters with vastly different personalities. In your daily interactions with the four furry characters, you gradually become attracted to their unique charm and unexpectedly touch upon their hidden secrets and the undercurrents of the city. As the relationship between the protagonist and them deepens, the hidden conflicts between humans and beasts gradually surface

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4164560/_Five_Heartbeats/]Steam[/url]]
